parsed.review_summary: The corrected rationale addresses all four error targets. It corrects the rubric misapplication by clarifying that the rubric requires a clearly defined concrete action, not low-level implementation specifics. It removes the unsupported claim about needing to specify datasets or metrics. It corrects the factual error about authors not knowing what to do. It fixes the score mapping error by mapping the reasoning to the highest actionability level. The rationale preserves the correct initial identification of the explicit action and does not state a numeric score or gold label. It is coherent and can be inserted into a rescoring pipeline.
